resources.string: From the course of the line and the position of the sun, Next Stop works out on which side the sun shines in during the ride. The hint shows on rides of 20 minutes or more, in daylight, and only when the weather forecast (Open-Meteo) says it is really sunny. Only the parts above ground count: a ride mostly in a tunnel, like most U-Bahn lines, gets no hint. For that, only a roughly rounded place (about 10 km) is sent to Open-Meteo.
On longer rides in daylight: on which side the sun shines in – only when it is really sunny.
Shows the hint of the sunny side on every ride, whatever the sun and the weather.
Cloud cover for the hint of the sunny side
